related_questions.question: Is the COVID pandemic still going on?

text_blocks.snippet: While the World Health Organization (WHO) declared an end to the COVID-19 Public Health Emergency of International Concern (PHEIC) on May 5, 2023, COVID-19 continues to circulate. The pandemic's official end is not clearly defined, and whether it's still considered a pandemic depends on the definition used. Currently, COVID-19 vaccines continue to offer protection against severe disease and death according to the WHO.
